name: Junie
desc: JetBrains' own coding agent, bundled with the IDE subscription
desc_zh: JetBrains 自研编程智能体，随 IDE 订阅一起提供
solves: Switching editors to get an agent means giving up your keybindings and setup. Junie arrives with the IDE subscription you already pay for.
solves_zh: 为了用 Agent 而换编辑器，等于放弃你原有的快捷键和配置。Junie 随你已经付费的 IDE 订阅直接提供。
best_for: When your team already lives in IntelliJ or PyCharm and will not move.
best_for_zh: 当你的团队本来就用 IntelliJ 或 PyCharm，不打算迁移。
notes: The agent for teams already paying JetBrains — no second editor, no second subscription, and a free AI tier since 2025.1. 来源：https://blog.jetbrains.com/pycharm/2025/04/pycharm-2025-1/
